blocks.text: There is no Gateway C0/C3 empirical outcome in this artifact. The PSA qualification slice stopped in C0 after 37 Chat Completions calls and `$0.093275` actual cost: that endpoint returned unversioned Flash and omitted routing metadata. A minimal OpenResponses probe returned exact 0731 and detailed dynamic provider/fallback attempts but no `usage.cost`. These controlled records establish an endpoint-level telemetry mismatch, not support for any hypothesis; C3 and the scorer did not run. Archived OpenRouter/Novita and unversioned-Flash smoke records remain historical operational evidence only.

The active evidence target is the STALE/CUPMem Phase 1 result package. Its upstream input freeze passed: the official repository commit and complete 400-case dataset hash/schema are recorded in `../../research/phase1/upstream_lock.json`. The exploratory S0–S3 pilot and official native scorer are recorded in `../../research/phase1/pilot_report.json`: S0 1/6, S1 6/6, S2 1/6, S3 5/6. The pre-registered stop/narrow gate fired because CUPMem matched or beat S3 on every native dimension in the sampled T1/T2 records; no held-out confirmatory matrix was run. The independent internal MemConflict mechanism check remains historical evidence only.
The package contains aggregate metrics and SHA-256 pointers only; raw prompts, traces, credentials, and model outputs remain outside Git in `PROOFPRESS_EVAL_HOME`.

Active STALE result entries must name the frozen configuration, task/source hashes, CUPMem revision, requested/resolved model, actual provider, per-call cost, fallback status/metadata, token/latency values, run records, native scorer output, semantic-information matching audit, and any applicable Proofpress capsule verification record. Missing telemetry is a qualification failure, not a zero-cost observation or permission for after-the-fact aggregate reporting. ARA indexes research meaning and evidence pointers; Proofpress supplies admitted lineage and independent verification, never a benchmark agent's implicit memory or raw session transcript.
